answers: To secure the phone connection before the interaction, follow the previous steps I've decribed. To optimize your actions for phone interaction, consider the following: 1. Do not include HTML elements in your action responses. Use Markdown for formatting instead. 2. Use a search extension to include search results in actions that the phone integration will read. history.content: What are the differences between query parameters and message parameters?

Query parameters and message parameters are two types of parameters sent from WebSocket API. Query parameters are sent when phone integration connects to the service and are used in queries written with the Discovery Query Language. Message parameters are sent as part of the JSON data in the request body.
can you tell me more about WebSocket API?

Of course! The WebSocket interface of the IBM Watson® Speech to Text service is the most natural way for a client to interact with the service. Because of their advantages, WebSockets are the preferred mechanism for speech recognition.  The WebSocket interface can take minutes to produce final results for a recognition request for an especially long audio file. For the WebSocket interface, the underlying TCP connection remains idle while the service prepares the response.
how can I use WebSocket API?

To use the WebSocket interface, you first use the /v1/recognize method to establish a connection with the service. You specify parameters such as the language model and any custom models that are to be used for requests that are sent over the connection. You then register event listeners to handle responses from the service. For the WebSocket interface, you first specify the customization ID with the language_customization_id parameter of the /v1/recognize method. You use this method to establish a WebSocket connection with the service. To use the WebSocket API for speech recognition, you first establish a persistent connection with the service using the /v1/recognize method. Then, you send text and binary messages over the connection to initiate and manage recognition requests. To synthesize text to speech with the WebSocket interface of the IBM Watson® Text to Speech service, you first establish a connection with the service by calling its /v1/synthesize method. You then send the text to be synthesized to the service as a JSON text message over the connection.
what is the customization ID here?

Customization_id identifies the custom model's Globally Unique Identifier (GUID). The GUID is used to identify the model in methods of the interface. You can specify the customization ID of the custom model to which the grammar is to be added.
I want to secure the phone connection before the integration

To secure the phone connection before integration, you can go to the Advanced options tab in the phone integration settings and select one or both of the following options:
1. Force secure trunking: This option uses Secure Real-Time Transfer Protocol (SRTP) to secure the audio that is transmitted over the phone.
2. Enable SIP authentication: This option requires SIP digest authentication for all inbound traffic. When this option is selected, the SIP digest user name and password must be configured, and the SIP trunk being used to connect to Assistant must be configured to use only TLS. However, if you use Twilio as your SIP trunk provider, you cannot enable SIP authentication for outbound SIP trunks to Watson Assistant.
Additionally, to configure how your assistant interacts with a SIP trunk from an external provider, go to the SIP trunk tab in the phone integration settings and update the SIP trunking integration section. Here, you can list the headers that you want your assistant to use in the "SIP INVITE headers to extract" field.

evidence.text:
When you use the phone integration as the first line of assistance for customers, it's a good idea to have a live agent backup available. You can design your assistant to transfer a call to a human in case the phone connection fails, or if a user asks to speak to someone.

Your company might already have one or more phone numbers that connect to an automatic call dispatcher (ACD) that can queue callers until an appropriate agent is available. If not, choose a call center service to use as your backup.

A conversation cannot be transferred from one integration type to another. For example, if you use the web chat integration with service desk support, you cannot transfer a phone call to the service desk that is set up for the web chat.

You can add security to the phone connection by going to the Advanced options tab in the phone integration settings, and selecting one or both of the following options:



* Force secure trunking: Select this option to use Secure Real-Time Transfer Protocol (SRTP) to secure the audio that is transmitted over the phone. For more information about RTP, see [Call routing details](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/watson-assistant?topic=watson-assistant-deploy-phone-configdeploy-phone-config-route).
* Enable SIP authentication: Select this option if you want to require SIP digest authentication.

When SIP authentication is required, all inbound traffic (meaning requests from the SIP provider to your assistant) is authenticated using SIP digest authentication, and must be sent using Transport Layer Security (TLS). If this option is selected, the SIP digest user name and password must be configured, and the SIP trunk being used to connect to Assistant must be configured to use only TLS.

To learn more about creating intents, watch the following 2 1/2-minute video.



 Intent creation overview 



* Plan the intents for your application.

Consider what your customers might want to do, and what you want your application to be able to handle on their behalf. For example, you might want your application to help your customers make a purchase. If so, you can add a buy_something intent. (The that is added as a prefix to the intent name helps to clearly identify it as an intent.)
* Teach Watson about your intents.

After you decide which business requests that you want your application to handle for your customers, you must teach Watson about them. For each business goal (such as buy_something), you must provide at least 5 examples of utterances that your customers typically use to indicate their goal. For example, I want to make a purchase.
